description: This file contains SCSS mixins for various gradient backgrounds, including linear, radial, directional, and striped gradients, used for styling within a CSS/SASS project.

methods.name: gradient-bg
methods.description: A mixin for applying a background color and optional gradient if enabled.

methods.name: gradient-x
methods.description: Creates a horizontal linear gradient from left to right with two color stops.

methods.name: gradient-y
methods.description: Creates a vertical linear gradient from top to bottom with two color stops.

methods.name: gradient-directional
methods.description: Creates a linear gradient at a specified angle with start and end colors.

methods.name: gradient-x-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a horizontal linear gradient with three specified colors and a color stop in between.

methods.name: gradient-y-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a vertical linear gradient with three colors and a midpoint stop.

methods.name: gradient-radial
methods.description: Creates a radial gradient with inner and outer colors.

methods.name: gradient-striped
methods.description: Creates a striped pattern with transparent and colored stripes at a specified angle.
